detail.title: JS55 Flight Simulator Joystick with Throttle Control
detail.overview: The Ant Esports JS55 is a joystick purpose-built for flight simulation, delivering high-precision control that enhances the realism of virtual flying across titles like Microsoft Flight Simulator, X-Plane 11 and War Thunder. It's loaded with 12 programmable buttons and 8-way hat switch functionality, letting you assign commands and functions for a genuinely personalized flying setup, while a dedicated throttle control system and acceleration button add authentic depth to takeoffs and combat manoeuvres. Vibrational feedback delivers tactile rumble that mimics engine vibrations and turbulence, deepening immersion in the cockpit. A heavy, stable base keeps the joystick planted during intense sessions, and true plug-and-play USB connectivity means it works instantly on any Windows-based PC or laptop with no drivers needed.
